FAQ

Questions people usually ask.

If something isn't answered here, it's faster to just ask directly.

Working together

Do you work with startups and individuals, or only companies?+

Both. Most of our work so far has been early-stage founders, students, and small teams who need something built end to end without hiring a full engineering team first.

What’s your typical timeline?+

It depends on scope. A focused single-feature build can ship in 1–2 weeks. A full product — model, API, frontend, deployment — usually runs 3–6 weeks. We give a real timeline after understanding the scope, not a generic estimate upfront.

Do you offer maintenance after launch?+

Yes, on a retainer basis. Launch is treated as a starting point, not an end date — see the Pricing page for how retainers work.

How do we start?+

Fill out the contact form with what you’re building. We reply personally, usually within a day or two, and the first conversation is just to understand the problem — no commitment.

What we build

Do you only build AI products, or regular software too?+

Both. AI is the specialty, but a lot of AI products fail because the engineering underneath — the API, the data pipeline, the frontend — is weak. We build the whole system, not just the model.

Will you tell us if AI isn’t actually the right fit?+

Yes. If a rules-based system or a simpler tool solves the problem better than a model would, we’ll say so, even if that means a smaller project.

Can you take over or extend an existing codebase?+

Yes. We regularly build on top of existing pipelines and codebases rather than starting from zero — it’s usually cheaper and faster for you.

Process

How involved do we need to be during the build?+

As much or as little as you want. Some clients want weekly check-ins, others just want the finished, working thing. We adapt to what’s useful for you.

Do we own the code and IP after the project?+

Yes, full ownership transfers on project completion and final payment, as agreed in the engagement terms.

Still have a question?

Ask us directly \u2014 we reply personally.
